title: Coca-Cola announces $6B investment in Mexico
body: The Coca-Cola Company announced a $6 billion investment in Mexico following a meeting between CEO Henrique Braun and President Claudia Sheinbaum.

context.text: Coca-Cola Plans Major US$6 billion Expansion in Mexico
why: Coca-Cola committed $6 billion to expand Mexican production and infrastructure, materially increasing its capital deployment.
date evidence (day)

title: CAR cuts Coca-Cola bottler water quota 42%
body: Cundinamarca's CAR reduced Indega's water capture from 3.23 to 1.9 liters per second, a 42% cut, and denied renewal for three of seven springs in La Calera.

context.text: Colombia reigns in Coca Cola bottler after environmental abuse claims
why: A 42% capacity cut at a Colombian bottler from a water quota reduction materially disrupts local supply.
date evidence (day)

title: Coca-Cola beats Q1 2026, raises outlook
body: Coca-Cola reported Q1 2026 net revenues up 12% to $12.5 billion beating estimates and raised full-year comparable EPS guidance to 8%-9% growth.

context.text: Coca-Cola Releases Q1 2026 Financial Results
why: Q1 2026 earnings beat estimates with 12% revenue growth and a raised profit outlook signal stronger performance.
date evidence (day)

title: Coca-Cola becomes Marriott global beverage partner
body: Marriott International and The Coca-Cola Company announced a global agreement making Coca-Cola Marriott's global beverage partner across categories including carbonated soft drinks, replacing Pepsi at properties worldwide.

context.text: Coca-Cola replaces Pepsi as beverage provider for hotel chain Marriott International
why: Securing Marriott's 9,700 global properties displaces Pepsi and materially expands KO's distribution footprint.
date evidence (day)

title: Engineer sues Coca-Cola over illegal quota
body: Scott Seccuro filed a federal lawsuit against The Coca-Cola Company on May 27, 2026, alleging gender and age discrimination, retaliation, and an illegal quota from its 50/50 by 2030 campaign, plus whistleblower retaliation under the FSMA.

context.text: Engineer sues Coca-Cola, alleges gender-parity goal became an 'illegal quota'
why: A federal lawsuit alleging discrimination and food safety retaliation creates legal and reputational risk for KO.
date evidence (day)

title: Coca-Cola explores 2027 India bottler listing
body: The Coca-Cola Company announced on June 1, 2026 it is exploring a 2027 public listing in India for Hindustan Coca-Cola Holdings Pvt. Ltd., parent of its largest bottler Hindustan Coca-Cola Beverages Pvt. Ltd.

context.text: The Coca-Cola Company Exploring Potential Public Listing in India for Hindustan Coca-Cola Holdings Pvt. Ltd., Parent Company of its Largest Bottler in India
why: Exploring a 2027 India listing of its largest bottler advances Coca-Cola's asset-light strategy and capital monetization.
date evidence (day)

title: Coca-Cola North America president steps down
body: The Coca-Cola Company announced on June 25, 2026 that Jennifer Mann will step down as EVP and President, North America Operating Unit effective Aug. 1, with John Murphy assuming responsibility on an interim basis.

context.text: Top Coca-Cola leader in its largest market to depart role
why: The North America president's departure is a major leadership change over a key region.
date evidence (day)

title: Coca-Cola launches new global visual identity system
body: The Coca-Cola Company launched a new global visual identity system on July 20, 2026, rolling out across more than 200 markets.

context.text: Coca-Cola unveils new global look, rolls out across 200+ markets
why: Coca-Cola launched a comprehensive global visual identity overhaul across 200+ markets, its largest brand architecture change in years.
date evidence (day)

title: Coca-Cola beats Q2 2026, raises forecast
body: The Coca-Cola Company reported Q2 2026 net revenues of $13.4 billion (up 7%) and raised full-year guidance to comparable EPS growth of 9%–10% and organic revenue growth of about 5%, citing World Cup-driven sales.

context.text: Coca-Cola hails World Cup hydration breaks as it lifts annual forecasts
why: Coca-Cola beat Q2 estimates and raised full-year guidance on World Cup sales, materially improving its 2026 outlook.
date evidence (day)

title: Coca-Cola and Fairlife data breach class action filed
body: A proposed class action was filed August 3, 2026 in U.S. District Court in Atlanta against Coca-Cola and Fairlife over a ransomware attack that exposed employee records and disrupted U.S. production.

context.text: Hackers hit Coca-Cola and Chick-fil-A. Now come the data breach lawsuits.
why: A ransomware attack exposed employee data and disrupted U.S. production, creating legal and operational risk.
date evidence (day)

title: FSSAI issues notice to Coca-Cola India over ads
body: On August 22, 2026, FSSAI stated it issued over 150 notices including to Coca-Cola India for misleading advertisements, false claims and labelling non-compliances, with some companies starting corrective action.

context.text: FSSAI issued 150 notices to food brands over misleading ads in recent weeks
why: India's food regulator issued notices for misleading ads, adding regulatory pressure in a key growth market.
date evidence (day)

title: Coca-Cola system announces $10B US infrastructure plan
body: The Coca-Cola system announced a system-wide $10 billion U.S. infrastructure investment from 2026 through 2030 covering new or expanded production, distribution and office facilities.

context.text: Coca-Cola to spend $10B on US manufacturing by 2030
why: Coca-Cola and bottlers committed $10B to U.S. infrastructure through 2030, a major capital plan affecting production and distribution.
date evidence (day)

title: Coca-Cola names Rob Gehring NA president
body: The Coca-Cola Company announced on Sept. 25, 2026 that Rob Gehring would become president of its North America operating unit effective Dec. 1, 2026, succeeding interim lead John Murphy.

context.text: The Coca-Cola Company Names Rob Gehring President of North America Operating Unit
why: Coca-Cola named Rob Gehring North America president, filling the leadership gap from the June step-down of Jennifer Mann.
date evidence (day)
